description: Change a member's roles in THIS tenant WITHOUT sending any email (admins only; ticket 86a7b144). Identify the person by user_id or email. role = DelegAIze role (admin|planner|viewer|caller); product_roles = object product → admin|planner|viewer (e.g. {"nodem": "admin", "tenderaize": "admin"}), null or {} = every product with the DelegAIze role. Pass either or both. Products: nodem, tenderaize, bookaize, supportaize, ernteapp, verain, complaiance, coachaize. The products pick up the new role at next sign-in or via the sync. Refuses to remove your own admin role or the last admin of the tenant. To send the invitation email use delegaize_user_invite.

product_roles.description: Role per product (admin, planner, viewer); null or {} = DelegAIze role everywhere

role.description: New DelegAIze role: admin, planner, viewer or caller

name: delegaize_user_roles_set
